semiconductor_relevance: High — SHIIMA Electronics provides specialized assembly and testing services for power devices and chiplets, which are critical in semiconductor packaging.
summary: SHIIMA Electronics offers comprehensive R&D solutions through contract services focused on power device and chiplet assembly prototyping, as well as reliability testing. Their capabilities include power device package assembly, chiplet mounting, and automated inspection services.
capabilities: Power device package assembly contract services
Power device reliability testing contract services
Automated X-ray inspection for chiplet mounting
